checkpoint_dir.description: Checkpoint path. Accepts a checkpoint-* directory or a run-* directory (the latest checkpoint inside the run-* is used).

framework.description: Benchmark framework(s) to evaluate on. One or more of: pbc, flip, pgym.

output_dir.description: Directory where autoeval results, H5 embeddings, and per-task outputs are written.

min_seq_length.description: Sequence length filters applied to benchmark datasets.

device.description: Device override. When None, picks 'cuda' if available else 'cpu'.

embedder_name.description: Embedder name shown in the autoeval report. When None, defaults to the checkpoint directory stem.

parallel_tasks.description: Number of parallel workers for downstream task training. 0 = sequential (runs through biotrainer's AutoEval, which also deduplicates and computes embeddings once across every requested framework). >0 = parallel mode (GPU embedding first, then CPU task training in a ThreadPoolExecutor).

development_mode.description: When True, biotrainer evaluates on data SUBSETS only. biotrainer defaults this to True; nanoPLM defaults to False so a plain run is a full evaluation.

zero_shot_method.description: Zero-shot scoring method when framework includes 'pgym'. One of: masked_marginals, wt_marginals, pseudoperplexity.

tasks.description: Optional whitelist of task names (e.g. PBC-secondary_structure). Parallel mode only — sequential mode warns and ignores.

force_download.description: Force re-download of framework datasets (use when new tasks land upstream).
